## Distillery Series

Woodford Reserve is announcing the latest addition to its esteemed Distillery Series, a limited-edition Cabernet Sauvignon Barrel Finish.

This expression continues the brand’s commitment to pushing creative boundaries under the leadership of Master Distiller Elizabeth McCall.

This new release features Woodford Reserve’s signature bourbon finished in hand-selected Cabernet Sauvignon barrels, resulting in a complex profile that marries the character of Kentucky bourbon with the rich, dark fruit nuances of the wine.

Recent Past Distillery Series expressions:

\*Distillery Series Tawny Port Finish (May 2025)

\*Distillery Series Chocolate Whisper Redux (Feb. 2025)

\*Distillery Series Blended Malt Sherry Cask Finish (October 2024)

\*Distillery Series Blended Malt (August 2024)

\*Distillery Series Toasted Bourbon (May 2024)

[Find in A Store](https://www.woodfordreserve.com/our-whiskey/product-locator/)
